faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-DKMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 01 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-DKMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 Sr. Consultant (Grade-1), 3 Young Professional - II, 1 Young Professional - I.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-DKMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 01 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Young Professional - II: 21 to 45 years; Young Professional - I: 21 to 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 80,000 per month for Sr. Consultant (Grade-1), 42,000 per month for Young Professional - II, 30,000 per month for Young Professional - I.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: YP-II (Editorial Work): Master's in Agricultural/Animal or allied sciences, or Master's in English Journalism, or Bachelor's in Agricultural/Animal or allied sciences with PG Diploma in English Journalism. YP-II (Publication Production): Degree/Diploma in Printing/Publishing Technology or graduation in Computer Application/IT/CS/AI/Computer Graphics, each with 60%. YP-II (Publication Management): MBA or two-year PG Diploma (Sales & Marketing/Advertisement), or B.Com/BBA/BBS with 60% and one. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. YP-I: knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Tally, etc.). Young Professionals are full time and may not hold any other work or appointment. Experience counts only after the prescribed qualification and must be supported by documentary evidence. Medical fitness certificate from a Government Hospital at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Qualification (20 marks). Experience (20 marks). Skill test (30 marks). Interview (30 marks).

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Sr. Consultants (Grade-I) initially engaged for three years. Young Professionals engaged for one year, extendable by two years (one year at a time), maximum three years (1+1+1). Engagement is purely time-bound, non-regular and gives no right to regularisation.
